title: Protocol to assess the tolerogenic properties of adoptively transferred dendritic cells during murine experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis
protocol: Prepare MOG injection solution and pertussis injection solution as described earlier.
Restrain mouse in restrainer.
Locate the right flank and apply 70% ethanol with a pipet tip to wet the fur and localize the injection site.
Subcutaneously inject mouse with 75 μL of MOG-emulsion and carefully remove the needle.
Repeat at left flank.
Draw pertussis injection solution in a 1 ml syringe.
Inject each mouse i.p. with 100 μl.
Two days later, repeat the preparation and injection of the pertussis solution.
Examine mice daily for weight loss and clinical symptoms starting on day 7 post EAE induction.
Classify clinical symptoms according to specified criteria.
Humanely euthanize mice according to ethical guidelines.
Spray skin with 70% ethanol to sterilize it.
Cut open abdominal skin with scissors and remove the whole hind leg from its skin layers.
Dislocate the hip joint without breaking it, then remove the whole hind-leg.
Place the removed leg in a falcon containing fresh PBS.
Isolate bones carefully to avoid breaking them.
Remove the paw and any muscle or connective tissue attached to the bones.
Place isolated bones in a 6-well dish filled with sterile PBS.
Prepare 50 mL falcons with pre-wetted 70 μm cell strainers.
Take tibia and femur, trim both ends using sterilized scissors to open up the bones.
Take a 5 mL syringe and fill it with 5 mL sterile PBS.
Attach a 27-gauge needle to the syringe.
Hold the tibia/femur over the prepared strainer.
Insert the needle into the narrow end of the tibia/femur.
Flush the bone marrow onto the 70 μM strainer.
Carefully disrupt bone marrow chunks with the tip of the serological pipet.
Wash the strainer with 10 mL PBS or culture medium.
Spin down cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant by inverting the falcon over a waste bottle.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL of erythrocyte-lysis buffer.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Stop erythrocyte lysis by adding 10 mL of culture medium.
Spin down cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant by inverting the falcon over a waste bottle.
Resuspend cell pellet in 10 mL of culture medium and count cells.
Seed 5 × 10^6 cells in 10 mL culture medium in a 10 cm tissue-culture treated petri-dish with 20 ng/mL GM-CSF and 5 ng/mL IL-4.
Put dishes in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 5 mL of fresh culture media with 20 ng/mL GM-CSF and 5 ng/mL IL-4 on day 3.
Harvest fully differentiated BM-DCs on day 6–7.
Check cell morphology and confluency under the microscope.
Carefully remove 6 ml of media directly from surface.
Pipette over the dish several times with remaining media to detach loosely attached cells.
Transfer cell suspension in a 15 ml falcon and count cells.
Spin down cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend 2 × 10^6 cells in 2 ml culture medium per well.
Plate resuspended cells in a 6 well plate.
Immediately add 10 μg/ml MOG35–55 to the plated cells.
Incubate cells for 5–6 h in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Harvest MOG-loaded BM-DCs using a cell scraper.
Transfer cell suspension into a 15 mL falcon tube.
Determine the cell number.
Spin down cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in sterile PBS at a concentration of 1 × 10^7 cells/mL.
Store cell suspension on ice until injections.
Randomize mice across experimental groups/conditions.
Anesthetize mice with isoflurane (2%–4% under constant oxygen flow).
Draw BM-DC cell suspension into a 1 mL syringe and mount a 27G needle.
Intravenously inject each mouse with 50 μL of the DC cell suspension via the retro-orbital sinusoid.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 10 μL staining mix and incubate for 15 min at RT.
Add 180 μL of 1% FCS/PBS and centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at RT.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend pellets in 150 μL 1% FCS/PBS.
If cells cannot be analyzed on the same day, resuspend cells in 100 μL eBioscience fixation buffer and incubate for 15 min at RT.
Spin cells at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature, discard the supernatant and resuspend in 150 μL 1% FCS/PBS.
Cells can now be stored at 4°C in the dark for several days.
Acquire samples on FACS machine.
Harvest spleen and inguinal lymph nodes from mice on day 17 post EAE induction.
Prepare a 6-well plate with a 70 μm strainer in each well, filled with 3 mL of sterile PBS. Place the plate on ice.
Place isolated spleens into separate wells containing PBS.
Mash spleen through the cell strainer using the plunger from a 5 mL syringe.
Wash the strainer with 5 mL of PBS and discard it.
Transfer splenocyte suspension to a 15 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 5 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Decant the supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL erythrocyte-lysis buffer, and incubate for 5 minutes at RT.
Fill up the falcon to 10 mL with PBS and spin down cells again at 500 g for 5 minutes at RT.
Decant the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of PBS.
Remove any cell clumps formed during erythrocyte lysis.
Transfer 200 μL splenocyte suspension into a 96-well plate for flow cytometry staining.
Mash lymph nodes through the strainer using the plunger from a 5 mL syringe.
Wash the strainer with 5 mL of PBS and discard it.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 5 minutes at RT.
Decant supernatant, resuspend pellet in 5 mL PBS, and transfer 200 μL lymph node suspension into a 96-well plate for flow cytometry staining.
Prepare antibody staining mix according to the table in materials and equipment.
Include single-staining controls for setting up proper compensation.
For critical surface markers, such as CD25, include fluorescence minus one (FMO) controls.
Centrifuge 96-well plates with spleen and lymph node cells at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant from the centrifuged wells.
Resuspend cells in 10 μL antibody staining mix and incubate for 15 min at room temperature in the dark.
Wash cells by adding 180 μL 1% FCS/PBS to each well.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant from the washed wells.
Prepare 1× Fix/Perm buffer using 1 part Fix/Perm concentrate and 3 parts Fix/Perm Diluent.
Resuspend pellets in 80 μL Fix/Perm buffer and incubate for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
Prepare 1× Perm buffer by diluting 1 part 10× Perm buffer with 9 parts ddH2O.
Wash cells by adding 100 μL 1× Perm buffer to each well.
Resuspend cells in 150 μL 1× Perm buffer.
Incubate resuspended cells for 5 min at RT in the dark.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at RT.
Discard supernatant and pause if necessary, otherwise proceed to intracellular staining.
Prepare the intracellular antibody staining mix in 1× Perm Buffer according to the materials and equipment list.
Resuspend cells in 10 μL of the prepared intracellular antibody staining mix.
Incubate for 30 min at RT in the dark.
Wash cells by adding 150 μL 1× Perm buffer.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at RT and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 150 μL 1% FCS/PBS.
Acquire samples on a FACS machine.
Analyze data using CytExpert and FlowJo.
